title: What the repository states, compiled
intro: knowledge discovers the declared source classes through the version-control index, derives one node per object it finds and one edge per relationship a file states, and reads no prose.

scenarios.title: The declared sources, discovered
scenarios.explain: Every row is a tracked file matched by a declared pathspec; nothing on the filesystem is looked at unless a class names it.

scenarios.title: Nodes of one kind
scenarios.explain: A rule's identity is the id in its front matter, so a rebuild after an edit keeps the node and every reference to it.

scenarios.title: A subcommand that does not exist
scenarios.explain: Usage errors exit 2 and name the help text; nothing is guessed from a near miss.
